title: Settings
description: Application preferences. Stored on this device.

appearance.themeHint: Light theme uses cream tones; dark theme uses deep warm grays.
appearance.languageHint: Applies to the entire application interface.

editor.debounceHint: After you stop typing for this long (5–600 s).
editor.intervalHint: Optional periodic save. Use 0 for idle-only saves.
editor.manualHint: With autosave off, use Save or Ctrl+S. Tabs show a dot when there are unsaved changes.

graph.autoRebuildOnView: Rebuild index when opening Graph view
graph.autoRebuildHint: Off by default. When enabled, edges are rebuilt from wiki-links and entity relations on each visit.

manuscript.dateFormatHint: Applies to “Last added date” and “Last date in document”.
